verdict.span: Now I have a complete picture of the project. Let me rewrite the FAQ to cover the actual commands, categories, currencies, data model, and common questions a new user would have.
verdict.reason: The request was underspecified about which FAQ topics and level of detail would be helpful, but the agent never surfaced that ambiguity or got agreement on a proposed set. It unilaterally chose the scope and rewrote the FAQ.
